VOL-I-12.2-02.reason: an obligation under the Project Agreement after award; not assessed at bid stage; Unresolved: the record that would show Financial Close within 270 days of the Preferred Bidder Notification cannot be specified, because the pack defines neither Financial Close nor 'the long-stop date' by which failure entitles the Authority to call the Bid Bond.
